verdicts.quote: the first eligible entry in join order is turned into a real booking, in the same atomic operation that freed the seat ... Promotion is automatic, with no accept/decline step.
entries are served strictly in join order ... two joins at the same instant get distinct join orders (no tie) ... Left out: priority by membership tier, by attendance record or by booking history
joining several overlapping classes' waitlists is allowed only to the extent the app already allows booking overlapping classes (G-2)
verdicts.missing: What happens to the member's Waiting entry for the overlapping class once they are promoted into one; only an indirect existing-overlap eligibility check at later promotion is implied.

verdicts.quote: a promoted member who cannot attend must cancel through the existing cancel flow (late-cancel rules apply as today)
any seat-freeing event (member cancels booking, staff removes a booking, staff raises capacity) ... Async completion: promotion is synchronous with the seat release (no queue, no worker)

one notification through the app's existing notification channel (G-3), stating the class, its time and the outcome ... channel returns an error → booking and entry stay Promoted, the failure is logged
two simultaneous cancellations free two seats ... exactly Cara and Dev promoted, Eli position 1; no one promoted twice.
a member with a Waiting entry who books directly gets ON_WAITLIST; entry unchanged ... resolve concurrent changes as if run one at a time (serialisable per session)
Preserved: every existing eligibility, credit/payment, overlap and cutoff rule ... head-of-queue Cara fails the check ... becomes Ineligible, Dev (next) is evaluated for the same seat
a waitlist length cap (G-5, default none) ... Maximum waitlist length per class ... No cap
When the class is no longer bookable under the app's existing rule (started or past cutoff), no join and no promotion happens ... the waitlist adds no second clock.
staff sets capacity 4 → Cara and Dev promoted in that order ... capacity 4 → 3 with booked 4 (staff cut): no booking is removed
when the studio cancels a class, every Waiting entry becomes Closed and the member is told (R-9).
Waitlist entry (member, session, join order, state, link to booking) ... Derived values (never stored as authority): position of a Waiting entry = 1 + number of Waiting entries ... earlier join order
entries are shown as "Class closed" and are never turned into bookings afterwards ... Retention of terminal entries follows existing booking-record retention until G-7 is decided.
A member sees their own position; they never see who else is queued ... any field carrying another member's name, email, id or avatar is a defect.
a staff member opens S1 and sees the ordered waiting members with their join order and can remove one entry
verdicts.missing: Manual promotion by staff and a staff view of who was promoted when are not stated; the whole staff view is conditional on G-4.

verdicts.quote: promotion is synchronous with the seat release (no queue, no worker); acknowledgement of a cancel means the promotion also committed or neither did
a class with free seats and no queue is booked and cancelled exactly as before ... existing clients that know nothing of the waitlist keep working
No migration of existing data is needed: entries start empty. ... a signed-in member viewing a full, bookable class can join its waitlist
